title: An Act to Establish the Maine Data Center Coordination Council and Place a Temporary Limitation on Certain Data Centers (TITLE CHANGE)

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to update certain laws regarding energy, utilities and technology.
